cohort: Two cohorts of children born in Nova Scotia between 1988 and 2014 (n = 262,729) and 1989 to 1993 (n = 42,999)
finding: No association was found between caesarean section and inflammatory bowel disease in two population-based cohorts of children in Atlantic Canada.
mod_finding: The study found no association between cesarean section and inflammatory bowel disease in children.
